title: Station wagon woman reappears at Changi Airport

tellings.quote: I'm in the airport, Jangi airport. Very famous.

plain: In 1990, a woman linked to an earlier encounter involving a station wagon turned up again at Changi Airport in Singapore. Peter Levenda, a writer described on the show as a historian of the CIA, the US foreign intelligence agency, tells Jesse Michels he was at the airport himself when it happened, though in the words given he says little more than where he was. He offers it as a strange reappearance of the kind that suggests something guiding events.
